item.title: PyPad 1.8.3
item.description: - PyPad 1.8.3 expands the built-in local tools framework under Tools with calculators, converters, reminders/taskers, reader mode, annotations, offline graphing, cached currency tools, and QR generation/scanning. - Built-in utilities now include Random Number Generator, Password Generator, Percentage / Finance Calculator, Scientific Calculator, Unit Converter, Equation Solver, Offline Graph Viewer, Cached Currency Tools, Timer / Stopwatch, Color Picker, World Clock, Reminders, Taskers, Clean Reader Mode, Highlights + Notes, and QR Generator / Scanner. - QR scanning now supports bundled general-purpose decoding through zxing-cpp, with a PyPad-local fallback path for generated matrix codes. - Editor right-click selection menus now expose built-in tools directly and auto-seed relevant dialogs from the current selection. - Tool dialogs continue to share help, copy, insert, save, and persisted local tool state. - Detailed changelog: CHANGELOG.md
